entries.sense_note: in the house or flat beside yours

def.short: in the house, flat or room that is right beside yours
def.long: In the house or flat that is right beside yours. You can live next door, or talk about the people next door.

grammar.pattern: live next door (to sb) / the people next door

examples.en: A new family moved in next door last week.
examples.tr: Geçen hafta yan eve yeni bir aile taşındı.

examples.en: The people next door are very friendly, and they often say hello.
examples.tr: Yan evdekiler çok cana yakın, sık sık selam veriyorlar.

examples.en: Priya went next door to ask her neighbor for some sugar.
examples.tr: Priya komşusundan biraz şeker istemek için yan eve gitti.

tr.note: Ev de olsa apartman dairesi de olsa 'next door' denir. İsimden önce tireyle yazılır: 'my next-door neighbor' (yan komşum).

quiz.cloze: We share a wall with Daniel. He lives ______.

def.short: making a lot of loud sound, or full of loud sounds
def.long: Making a lot of loud, often unpleasant sound, or full of this kind of sound. People, places, streets and machines can all be noisy.

examples.en: The kids are really noisy today.
examples.tr: Çocuklar bugün çok gürültücü.

examples.en: Hakan can't work at home because the street outside is so noisy.
examples.tr: Dışarıdaki sokak çok gürültülü olduğu için Hakan evde çalışamıyor.

examples.en: The old washing machine is really noisy, so we only use it during the day.
examples.tr: Eski çamaşır makinesi çok gürültülü, o yüzden onu sadece gündüz kullanıyoruz.

tr.note: 'Loud' çoğunlukla sesin kendisi için kullanılır: 'loud music'. 'Noisy' daha çok ses çıkaran kişi, yer ya da makine için: 'a noisy street'. Kesin kural değildir; 'loud neighbors' da denir.

quiz.cloze: I can't sleep here. The street outside is very ______ at night.

def.micro: an extra key for a door
def.short: an extra copy of a key that you keep in a safe place
def.long: An extra copy of a key that you keep in a safe place in case you lose your own. People often give one to a neighbor, a friend or a family member.

examples.en: My mom has a spare key to my apartment.
examples.tr: Annemde dairemin yedek anahtarı var.

examples.en: Ece gave a spare key to her neighbor before she went on holiday.
examples.tr: Ece tatile gitmeden önce komşusuna yedek anahtar verdi.

examples.en: Daniel lost his keys, but luckily his roommate had a spare key.
examples.tr: Daniel anahtarlarını kaybetti ama neyse ki ev arkadaşında yedek anahtar vardı.

collocations: a spare key to the house

tr.note: 'Spare' burada 'yedek, fazladan' demektir: 'a spare tire' (stepne), 'spare time' (boş vakit).

quiz.cloze: I always leave a ______ with my neighbor, just in case.

def.short: be quieter; used when you ask someone to make less noise
def.long: An informal way to ask someone to make less noise. People often say it to neighbors, roommates or children. With 'Could you … please?' it sounds polite.

grammar.pattern: Could you keep it down? (no object)

examples.en: Could you keep it down, please? I'm on the phone.
examples.tr: Biraz sessiz olur musun lütfen? Telefondayım.

examples.en: Nora knocked on the wall and asked her neighbors to keep it down.
examples.tr: Nora duvara vurdu ve komşularından biraz sessiz olmalarını istedi.

examples.en: Keep it down, kids! The baby is sleeping upstairs.
examples.tr: Çocuklar, sesinizi biraz kısın! Bebek yukarıda uyuyor.

tr.note: Bir rica cümlesidir; 'Could you…, please?' ile söylenince kibar olur. Müzik ya da TV gibi bir cihazın sesini kısmak için 'turn it down' denir.

quiz.cloze: It's after midnight and people are trying to sleep. Could you ______, please?

entries.sense_note: the bell at a front door

def.micro: a button you press at a door
def.short: a button next to a door that makes a sound when a visitor presses it
def.long: A button next to the door of a house or flat. When a visitor presses it, it makes a sound inside, so you know someone is there.

examples.en: I think the doorbell is ringing. Is it the pizza?
examples.tr: Sanırım kapı zili çalıyor. Pizza mı geldi?

examples.en: The doorbell rang while Priya was in the shower.
examples.tr: Priya duştayken kapı zili çaldı.

examples.en: Our doorbell is broken, so please knock when you arrive.
examples.tr: Kapı zilimiz bozuk, o yüzden gelince lütfen kapıyı tıklatın.

tr.note: Türkçede 'kapı çalıyor' hem zil hem kapıya vurmak için denir. İngilizcede zil için 'the doorbell rings', kapıya vurmak için 'knock' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: Someone rang the ______, so Nora went to open the door.

def.short: open the door and allow someone or something to come inside
def.long: To allow a person or an animal to come into a room or building, often by opening the door for them. The person usually goes between the two words: 'let me in'.

examples.en: I forgot my key. Can you let me in?
examples.tr: Anahtarımı unuttum. Beni içeri alır mısın?

examples.en: Oscar opened the back door and let the cat in.
examples.tr: Oscar arka kapıyı açtı ve kediyi içeri aldı.

examples.en: The security guard won't let anyone in after ten o'clock.
examples.tr: Güvenlik görevlisi saat ondan sonra kimseyi içeri almıyor.

tr.note: Kişi iki kelimenin arasına girer: 'let me in', 'let the dog in'. Zamir olunca araya girmesi zorunludur; 'let in me' denmez.

quiz.cloze: I'm outside your door and it's raining! Please ______.

entries.sense_note: be outside with your keys inside

def.short: close a locked door by mistake and leave your keys inside
def.long: To close a locked door by mistake while your keys are still inside, so you cannot get back in. Change 'yourself' to match the person: 'I locked myself out.'

examples.en: Oh no! I locked myself out of my flat again.
examples.tr: Eyvah! Anahtarı içeride unuttum, yine kapıda kaldım.

examples.en: Ece locked herself out, so she waited for her roommate to come home.
examples.tr: Ece kapıda kaldı, o yüzden ev arkadaşının gelmesini bekledi.

examples.en: If you lock yourself out, call me. I have a spare key.
examples.tr: Kapıda kalırsan beni ara. Bende yedek anahtar var.

tr.note: Kapıyı kapatıp anahtarı içeride unutunca Türkçede 'kapıda kalmak' denir. 'Yourself' kişiye göre değişir: myself, himself, herself, ourselves.

quiz.cloze: I left my keys inside and ______. Now I have to wait on the stairs.

entries.sense_note: a person who rents a home

def.short: a person who pays money to live in a house or flat that someone else owns
def.long: A person who pays money every month to live in a house or flat that belongs to someone else. The owner is called the landlord.

examples.en: The flat upstairs has a new tenant, a young nurse.
examples.tr: Üst kattaki dairenin yeni bir kiracısı var, genç bir hemşire.

examples.en: The landlord asked all the tenants to pay the rent by the fifth.
examples.tr: Ev sahibi bütün kiracılardan kirayı ayın beşine kadar ödemelerini istedi.

examples.en: Leyla has been a tenant in this building for six years.
examples.tr: Leyla altı yıldır bu binada kiracı.

etymology.text: From Old French 'tenant', meaning 'holding', from the verb 'tenir', to hold, which comes from Latin 'tenere'.

tr.note: Evin sahibine 'landlord' (kadınsa 'landlady') denir. Kirayı ödeyerek evde oturan kişi ise 'tenant' olur.

quiz.cloze: Hakan rents a flat from Mr. Brown. Hakan is the ______, and Mr. Brown is the landlord.

entries.sense_note: a person who shares your home

def.short: a person who is not your family but shares a flat, house or room with you
def.long: A person who lives in the same flat, house or room as you, but is not your family or partner. Students and young workers often live this way to share the rent.

examples.en: My roommate Nora cooks dinner for us on Fridays.
examples.tr: Ev arkadaşım Nora cuma günleri bize akşam yemeği yapıyor.

examples.en: Priya is looking for a roommate because the rent is too high.
examples.tr: Kira çok yüksek olduğu için Priya ev arkadaşı arıyor.

examples.en: Arda and his roommate take turns cleaning the kitchen.
examples.tr: Arda ve ev arkadaşı mutfağı sırayla temizliyor.

tr.note: İngiliz İngilizcesinde aynı evi paylaşan kişiye çoğunlukla 'flatmate' denir. Amerikan İngilizcesinde 'roommate' hem ev hem oda arkadaşı için kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: Omar and I aren't family, but we live together and share the rent. He's my ______.

def.short: available for people to live in or use if they pay money every month
def.long: Offered to people who want to live in it or use it and pay money every month, but not buy it. You often see it on signs. In the UK, 'to let' is also used.

grammar.pattern: a flat / house / room for rent

examples.en: There's a nice flat for rent near the park.
examples.tr: Parkın yakınında kiralık güzel bir daire var.

examples.en: Ayşe saw a 'For Rent' sign on the house across the street.
examples.tr: Ayşe karşıdaki evde 'Kiralık' tabelası gördü.

examples.en: Are there any cheap apartments for rent in this neighborhood?
examples.tr: Bu mahallede ucuz kiralık daire var mı?

tr.note: 'For sale' satılık demektir. Türkçedeki gibi isimden önce değil, sonra gelir: 'a flat for rent' (kiralık bir daire).

quiz.cloze: Ece can't buy a house, so she is looking for a flat ______.
